sources.title: Piracy monthly report February 2025
sources.text: Four robbers armed with gun and knives boarded the ship underway. 3/E was taken hostage and tied up in the engine room. The 3/E managed to escape and informed the Master. Alarm raised, ship’s horn sounded, and crew mustered. Seeing the alerted crew, the robbers escaped with stolen engine spares. The incident was reported to VTIS West.
